## Intention

input file: 03_dat_aug.tsv\
outputfile: 06_key_plot_3.png

Load libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

Load data

```{r}
data_aug <- read_tsv(here("data/03_dat_aug.tsv"))
```

```{r}
data_aug
```

```{r}
data_aug |> 
  filter(Lesion_type == "Peritoneal lesion" |
           (Group == "Control" & Tissue == "Peritoneum")
  ) |> 
  select(-Lesion_type,-Tissue) |> 
  mutate(Rel_expr = Expression - mean(Expression[Group == "Control"], na.rm = TRUE))

  
```
